stories.title: ¿Puede un bombero, policía o trabajador social negarse a participar en un desahucio?: “Se nos instrumentaliza para blanquearlos”

en.title: Can a firefighter, police officer or social worker refuse to participate in an eviction?: "We are being used to legitimize them"
en.summary: Some firefighters and social workers are questioning whether participating in evictions should be part of their duties and are requesting not to be deployed for these operations.

stories.title: Un pueblo alemán prohíbe poner más ‘stolpersteine’, los adoquines conmemorativos de las víctimas del nazismo

en.title: A German town bans placing more 'stolpersteine', commemorative cobblestones for Nazi victims
en.summary: A far-right motion in the German town of Heidenau passed after receiving votes from CDU council members, restricting the placement of memorial stones honoring Holocaust victims.

stories.title: Los decretos de vivienda llegan al Congreso sin estar amarrados y Podemos y Junts avisan: “Mirad el marcador”

en.title: Housing decrees reach Congress unresolved and Podemos and Junts warn: "Look at the scoreboard"
en.summary: The government views upcoming congressional debate on housing decrees as a risky but necessary step toward the end of the legislative term, with coalition partners issuing warnings.

stories.title: Los inquilinos de renta media ahorrarán 500 euros en el IRPF si la autonomía declara la zona tensionada

en.title: Middle-income tenants will save 500 euros in income tax if the autonomous community declares the area in housing tension
en.summary: A tax deduction for renters earning up to 33,000 euros annually was approved, with a maximum cost of 820 million euros, applicable when regions declare housing stress zones.

stories.title: Ceuta, dos meses después: una ciudad paralizada entre la expulsión y el retorno de los migrantes

en.title: Ceuta, two months later: a city paralyzed between migrant expulsion and return
en.summary: Two months after a large-scale migrant crossing, Ceuta faces ongoing social tension while awaiting the start of migrant expulsions from the city.

stories.title: El Rey, ante Macron y Sánchez, sobre Ceuta: «La intrusión masiva violando una frontera es inaceptable»

en.title: The King, before Macron and Sánchez, on Ceuta: "Massive intrusion violating a border is unacceptable"
en.summary: King Felipe VI addressed the Ceuta crisis caused by the massive entry of thousands of people two months earlier during a gala dinner at the Royal Palace with French President Macron and Spanish Prime Minister Sánchez, calling the intrusion unacceptable and requesting European solidarity.

stories.title: La Reina elige un vestido prestado de Carolina Herrera para la diadema floral

en.title: The Queen chooses a borrowed Carolina Herrera dress for the floral tiara
en.summary: Brigitte Macron wore a white and silver Louis Vuitton dress at an official event.

stories.title: El Rey exige ante Macron más apoyo de la UE en Ceuta: “Es una responsabilidad de todos”

en.title: The King demands more EU support from Macron on Ceuta: "It is a responsibility of all"
en.summary: During the gala dinner at the Royal Palace, King Felipe VI demanded greater EU support for Ceuta, calling the massive intrusion of tens of thousands of people unacceptable due to its security and public order challenges.

stories.title: La Reina Letizia brilla con la tiara floral, los pendientes de chatones y un vestido prestado de Carolina Herrera New York, y Brigitte Macron con un look blanco y plata

en.title: Queen Letizia shines with the floral tiara, chandelier earrings and a borrowed Carolina Herrera New York dress, and Brigitte Macron with a white and silver look
en.summary: Queen Letizia wore a floral tiara with a borrowed Carolina Herrera dress at a gala dinner in the Royal Palace during the French president's state visit to Spain.

stories.title: El Rey habla ante Macron sobre Ceuta: “No podemos afrontar solos una responsabilidad que es de todos”

en.title: The King speaks to Macron about Ceuta: "We cannot face alone a responsibility that belongs to everyone"
en.summary: Spain's King Felipe VI appealed to Brussels for responsibility in managing the crisis in the autonomous city of Ceuta, describing the situation as unacceptable.

stories.title: La Premier declara culpable al Manchester City de ocultar sus cuentas e inflar sus ingresos más de 1.000 millones de euros

en.title: The Premier declares Manchester City guilty of concealing accounts and inflating revenue by over 1 billion euros
en.summary: Manchester City faces Premier League charges of financial misconduct involving hidden accounts and inflated income, though the club denies all allegations.

stories.title: La Premier League oficializa la sanción al Manchester City: culpable de casi todos los cargos

en.title: Premier League officially sanctions Manchester City: found guilty of almost all charges
en.summary: Manchester City has been found guilty of nearly all charges brought against it by the Premier League. The process to determine specific penalties will now begin.

stories.title: Mercadona crece en Portugal y ya vende al 55% de los hogares

en.title: Mercadona grows in Portugal and now sells to 55% of households
en.summary: Spanish retailer Mercadona has strengthened its position as Portugal's fourth largest grocery operator with a 7.4% market share. The company plans to reach 81 stores by year-end, having invested over 1.2 billion euros since entering the market in 2019.

stories.title: El Gobierno prohíbe a los "fondos buitre" comprar pisos hasta 2028

en.title: Government prohibits 'vulture funds' from buying apartments until 2028
en.summary: Spain's Congress will vote Friday on two decrees including restrictions on investment funds purchasing residential properties, rental protections, tax relief measures, and foreclosure moratoriums.

stories.title: Sabadell reordena sus centros y crea un 'hub' de proyectos

en.title: Sabadell reorganizes its centers and creates a project 'hub'
en.summary: Bank Sabadell plans to restructure buildings in Sant Cugat, Las Tablas, and Alicante while selling three properties.

stories.title: La gran fuga fiscal: ¿hacia dónde huye el dinero global?

en.title: The great fiscal exodus: where is global money fleeing?
en.summary: Various jurisdictions compete to attract wealthy taxpayers through different tax strategies, ranging from Italy's flat tax to tax-neutral Caribbean locations.

en.title: How is condominium extinction taxed?
en.summary: The dissolution of joint property ownership where one party retains the property and compensates the other has favorable tax treatment in Spain compared to ordinary property sales, involving three taxes.
